body: Founder direction: launch into the air, fold into a paper airplane, glide clear of danger, flying over terrain and immune to ground-based CC while airborne. Specified in docs/HEROES_VS0.md as a Q, consistent with the Donkey's existing Indirect-Control identity (auto-triggered alongside Immortal's Fold, not player-cast). Docs only -- The Donkey stays blocked on a non-piloted-unit system that doesn't exist in arena_game.c yet, flagged explicitly rather than shoehorned into the owner-piloted sim. REDGARDEN 5c2a54c.
